Release of Aoba 1.4.4 for Fabric 1.21.3 and 1.21.4

Everyone asked, so you shall receive! People thought updates were taking too long... and I agree with them. There don't appear to be any major bugs that I was able to find, but with any large system rework, expect some bugs. I would appreciate if any bugs could be reported on here or our Discord. More updates will be out soon to address some issues with this release, stay tuned.

Please be aware that this client requires both Fabric and the latest Fabric API, which can be found at:
[link](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api)

![2024-12-08_20 11 26](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1917865c-4392-4860-984d-b5fe095265ab)

If you experience any crashing, **please** delete the Aoba config folder located in %appdata%/.minecraft/aoba. This is especially important because of the new settings system.

## What's Changed
* Reworked GUI system once again, allowing for horizontal elements.
* Added Macro System (WIP) that records your actions and can replay them.
* Added Module toggle save state that persists between game sessions.
* Added hot-swappable settings that can be saved and loaded from the disk.
* Added plenty of Aura settings to help bypass AntiCheats (TUNE YOUR CLIENT FOR EACH SERVER/ANTICHEAT!)
* Added BedAura module
* Added toggle-able Custom Main Menu (found in-game in HUD page)
* Added NoEntityPush to AntiKnockback (by @Logging4J)
* Added Discord icon to Main Menu (by @Logging4J)
* Added toggle-able Discord Presence (Discord RPC) (by @discomal101)
* Added powder snow overlay to NoRender (by @Logging4J)
* Fixed a multitude of UI crashes and bugs. 
* Fixed TTF font loading size and width calculations (by @TangyKiwi)
* Fixed issue where AntiHunger would crash the game when switching servers.
* Fixed issue where Aimbot and KillAura would not be aimed at the correct position of some entities.
* Fixed crash that would occur when using mouse buttons that are non-standard. 
* Fixed font manager not loading fonts properly (by @TangyKiwi)
* Fixed issue where ClickTP had the possibility to crash the client when using FreeCam

Release of Aoba 1.4.3 for Fabric 1.21.x

Please be aware that this client requires both Fabric and the latest Fabric API, which can be found at:
[link](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api)

* If you experience any crashing, please delete the Aoba config folder located in %appdata%/.minecraft/aoba

![2024-09-22_11 45 39](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/52dfe6a2-8db2-4f55-89b3-fd78dc449a8c)

## What's Changed
* Added Addon System. (by @cvs0)
* Added Proxy System. (by @cvs0)
* Added Baritone implementation (by @cvs0)
* Added reworked main menu  (by @cvs0 and @coltonk9043)
* Added FastLadder module. (by @Xatsec)
* Added Speed module. (by @Xatsec)
* Added Strafe module. (by @Xatsec)
* Added ClickTP module.
* Added EntityControl module.
* Added ReverseStep module.
* Added AntiHunder module.

* Added GUIMove module. (by @cvs0)
* Added AutoShear module.
* Added XCarry module.
* Added MiddleClickAction module (by @cvs0)
* Added NoRender module (by @cvs0)
* Added FocusFPS module (by @cvs0)
* Added Barrels to ChestESP.
* Added 3 Pathfinders. (Walking, Flying, Teleporting)
* Added experimental MobESP/PlayerESP rendering mode.
* Added ability to resize Windows and HUD elements by dragging on their borders.
* Added different cursors when hovering certain elements / performing certain actions.
* Added more No-Fall settings.
* Added more NoClip settings.
* Added more Jetpack settings.
* Added more Fly settings.
* Added more FakePlayer settings.
* Added more AntiKnockback settings. (by @Logging4J)
* Added more AutoEat settings.
* Added more rotation settings to Aimbot, Crystal Aura, and KillAura.
* Added ability to text-align certain HUD elements (such as module list)
* Added Tooltips to modules that displays their description (by @cvs0)
* Added Z-Index to HUD elements.
* Added update notifcation to Main Menu.
* Added DiscordRPC for discord integration.
* Added back HUD color modes (Rainbow, Random)
* Split InfoHUD into seperate HUD elements (TimeHud, PingHud, FPSHud, CoordsHud, etc)
* Fixed AltManager.
* Fixed Trajectory module.
* Fixed CrystalAura bugs and added several settings. (by @cvs0 and @coltonk9043)

* Fixed Sneak not sneaking properly. (by @cvs0)
* Fixed ESP model interpolation. (by @cvs0)
* Fixed ArmorHUD not displaying armor correctly.
* Fixed a million crash issues.
* Updated animations across many UI elements. (by @cvs0 and @coltonk9043)

# Notes
I'd like to thank all of the help I've received from all of the contributors; especially cvs0, who has contributed a huge amount of time to improving Aoba. This is one of the biggest single updates I have ever released, and there is much more planned. 
cvs0 is also working on another project, check it out here: [squidhack](https://www.squidhack.cc/)

From here on out, I want to try to commit to more frequent updates and a much higher standard for the quality of each module, with a large focus on PvP modules specifically. I understand that Aoba's combat modules are lacking when it comes to timings, anticheat bypasses, and customizability, and I hope to be able to improve upon them in the near future.

Thanks again for all of your support. Let's make Aoba one of the best ;)

releases.notes:
### Release of Aoba 1.4.0 for Fabric 1.20.2-1.20.4.

Full release of Aoba 1.4.0... finally.

Please be aware that this client requires both Fabric and the latest Fabric API, which can be found at:
[link](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api)
* Please note that different versions will require different APIs. Please ensure you download the correct one.

### Changelog:

- All changes from 1.4.0 prelease have been implemented.

- New TTF Font system that allows loading of user-defined fonts at launch.

- Global chat is now up and running smooth. No more glitchy chat.

- UI Text will now wrap properly (most of the time)

- Module bug fixes.

![image](https://github.com/coltonk9043/Aoba-MC-Hacked-Client/assets/56643581/6896fdd0-8a12-40c6-9569-231cc6d91606)

### FAQ:
**Q: How do I install custom fonts?**
A: You can install fonts by placing them into `%appdata%\.minecraft\aoba\fonts`. These fonts will then be picked up the next time you boot the game. We included a bundle of recommended fonts but you are free to use your own. Medium/Bold fonts work best due to the limitations of Minecraft's TTF renderer.

**Q: Tilda does not work for me. How do I open the ClickGUI?**
A: You can open the ClickGUI with commands now. Type `.aoba clickgui open`

**Q: Where did the module selector go?**
A: It is still there, but must be added through the ClickGUI first. You will only have to do this once. Sorry about this!

**Q: No Rainbow color?**
A: Coming in 1.4.1!

**Install Instructions:**
Simply drag the jar file into your .minecraft/mods folder with Fabric installed. This folder is located in %appdata%.

* add back ability to pin tabs by @OsakiTsukiko in https://github.com/coltonk9043/Aoba-MC-Hacked-Client/pull/22
* Osettings by @OsakiTsukiko in https://github.com/coltonk9043/Aoba-MC-Hacked-Client/pull/23
